parent_objective: design boundary retargeting after source-step replay smoke found zero history positives and many normal failures
blocked_by: M1452 replay pressure is not normal-viable near-boundary enough
supersedes: training from M1452 zero-positive replay rows

public_gates: M1454 must design normal-viable near-boundary retargeting before any replay rerun
M1454 must use M1452 actual replay diagnostics
M1454 must not run replay train PPO promote use private holdout export corpus or change actor inputs

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs replay boundary retargeting from M1452 diagnostics
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no replay run, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design ignores normal viability
stop if design routes directly to training
stop if design lowers self-ID standard because M1452 was negative
fallback_plan: route to implementation if retarget design is concrete
route to branch synthesis if replay retargeting is not justified

blocked_shortcuts: do not run replay in this design
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up implementation or synthesis manifest

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1454 is design and makes no history-necessity claim.
history_necessity_tests: future retargeted replay must again test normal history against history interventions
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Use M1452 negative result to improve task pressure, not to lower the evidence bar.
allowed_claims: no replay result, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1452 failed to produce history positives because replay pressure was not normal-viable near-boundary enough, so a boundary retarget design is the next admissible step.
success_criteria: design uses M1452 actual replay diagnostics
design blocks training and corpus export
failure_criteria: design routes directly to training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input change
decision_rule: M1454 passes if it designs normal-viable near-boundary retargeting before replay rerun or training.
